messages.subject: membership applications
parts:
It's that time of year when random names pop up requesting membership.
If there is a comment included telling me/us who the person is and their
interest in R, I've been giving approval. I've been ignoring others.

If you are planning to mentor or advise anyone to apply, do tell them to
let us know at least some information that suggests it is worthwhile
approving them. Early on we approved everyone and got spam emails. And
there are always those who try blanket applications in the hope they'll
get lucky and get some money.

Best, JN
